top_signals.title: Japan axes Netflix collaboration after outcry over dating show
top_signals.summary: The Justice Ministry axed the tie-up with "Badly In Love," which features ex-juvenile delinquents, following backlash against what some called the glorification of crimes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
